# When is the final paycheck legally due?

> Free calculator for the legal deadline on a departing employee's final paycheck — by US state and separation type (fired/laid off vs. quit), including California's notice-based rule, Minnesota's demand-triggered 24-hour rule, and whether the state requires accrued unused vacation/PTO to be paid out.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
